v1_wrong_http_method.detail: create_user() uses POST method. Route: POST /api/v1/users.

v2_camelcase_route.detail: Route /createPost renamed to /api/v1/users/search, function renamed to search_users().

v3_no_pagination.detail: list_users() supports page (default 1) and page_size (default 20) query params. Response envelope includes users, page, page_size, total.

v4_wrong_status_codes.detail: create=201, get not-found=404, delete=204, create client-error=400, stats client-error=400. All status codes match G4 spec.

v5_missing_api_prefix.detail: All 8 routes prefixed with /api/v1/: POST users, GET users, GET users/<id>, PUT users/<id>, DELETE users/<id>, GET users/search, GET users/health, GET users/stats.

v6_bare_string_errors.detail: All 5 error returns use jsonify() with {"error": "...", "code": "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE"}: create_user missing-field (400, MISSING_FIELD), get_user not-found (404, NOT_FOUND), update_user not-found (404, NOT_FOUND), delete_user not-found (404, NOT_FOUND), get_stats bad group_by (400, INVALID_PARAMETER).

schema_completeness.detail: All 11 config keys (queue_url, concurrency, max_retries, retry_backoff_seconds, job_timeout, log_level, dead_letter_queue, heartbeat_interval, prefetch_count, ack_on_failure, metrics_enabled) present with correct types, defaults, env_vars, and validation rules.

type_coercion.detail: int, float, bool, enum, string coercion correctly implemented. Bool accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off (case-insensitive). int coercion guards against isinstance(True, int) pitfall.

validation_rules.detail: non-empty for queue_url, range [min,max] for all int keys, allowed list for log_level enum (case-sensitive). All ranges match spec exactly.

priority_cascade.detail: cli_args > env_vars > config_file > defaults. env_vars defaults to os.environ. Unknown keys silently ignored. FileNotFoundError on missing config file.

api_contract.detail: ConfigValidationError(ValueError), load_config(config_file, env_vars, cli_args) -> dict, get_schema() -> dict, validate_value(key, value) -> coerced value. Error messages include key name and invalid value.

config_file_format.detail: JSON format supported. Unknown keys silently ignored per spec.

schema_runtime_access.detail: get_schema() returns _SCHEMA at runtime as specified. Schema is defined in code, not loaded from config_schema.json.
